record.original_question: Let I be a monomial ideal such that the quotient R/I has the weak Lefschetz property in characteristic zero. For which characteristics of the ground field does the same quotient fail to have the weak Lefschetz property?

evidence.quote: Question 2.10. Let I be a monomial ideal such that R/I has the WLP in characteristic zero. What are the field characteristics in which R/I fails to have the WLP?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K$ be a field and $R = K[x_1, \ldots, x_n]$ the polynomial ring in $n$ variables. A standard graded Artinian algebra $A = R/I$ is said to have the **weak Lefschetz property (WLP)** if there exists a linear form $\ell \in A_1$ such that, for every $i \geq 0$, the multiplication map
$$\times \ell : A_i \longrightarrow A_{i+1}$$
has maximal rank (i.e., is either injective or surjective).

Suppose $I \subset R$ is a monomial ideal such that $R/I$ is Artinian and such that, when the ground field $K$ has characteristic zero, the algebra $R/I$ possesses the weak Lefschetz property.

Determine, in terms of $I$, the set of prime characteristics $p$ for which the corresponding algebra $R/I$ (with $K$ taken to be a field of characteristic $p$) fails to have the weak Lefschetz property.
artifact.category_tag: Weak Lefschetz property of monomial ideals
artifact.status_search_result: The characteristic dependence of the weak Lefschetz property for monomial ideals is widely cited as a longstanding open problem. Partial results exist (e.g., Han's theorem and subsequent work for monomial complete intersections in three variables, and recent progress on monomial almost complete intersections), but a complete classification of the prime characteristics where WLP fails for an arbitrary monomial ideal with WLP in characteristic zero is not known.

status_evidence.title: Monomial ideals, almost complete intersections and the Weak Lefschetz Property
status_evidence.snippet: results exemplify the intriguing dependence of the property on the characteristic of the ground field
status_evidence.claim: Characteristic dependence of WLP for monomial ideals is an active subject with only partial classifications.

status_evidence.title: Forcing the weak Lefschetz property for equigenerated monomial ideals
status_evidence.snippet: classifying when WLP holds in positive characteristic
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to address WLP failure in positive characteristic, indicating the general question remains open.
